_categories.DS: Directed-segment distance on the squared-Euclidean (non-metric) case40: the rule from De Caceres et al. 2019 eqs. 8-10 (with ecotraj's min-endpoint penalty) matches 39/40 cases; on case40 the corrected-triangle quantities used for the relative position / penalty differ from ecotraj's. DSPD inherits it. Round 6: the 3 differing segment pairs involve corrected triplets exactly collinear in exact arithmetic (rounding-noise sign decides between penalty L+0 and L+endpoint distance); see docs/PARITY.md.
_categories.NONMETRIC: Non-metric input (squared-Euclidean, Bray-Curtis): after the local additive triangle correction some triplets become collinear to the last bit, and ecotraj's output there (0, ~1e-6 deg, 180, or NaN) depends on its exact floating-point operation order, which black-box probing (about 60 candidate orders on ~14,000 crafted triplets) did not reproduce bit-for-bit. Reproduced: clamp on corrected triplets, NaN for d_ik = 0.
